target.statement: PoseDet with DLA-34 backbone achieves 59.2 AP on COCO test-dev without TTA

compute.basis: Training PoseDet on COCO requires 8 V100 GPUs for 210 epochs; even the smallest backbone (DLA-34) needs days of GPU time, and no code is released.

blockers: Requires 8 NVIDIA V100 GPUs for training
title: PoseDet: Fast Multi-Person Pose Estimation Using Pose Embedding
